summary: Tested the new 'Números por agente' feature (extra numbers: 1 per agent/branch, 10 €/month ES and 13.000 CLP/month CL), backend and frontend. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. Covered: GET /api/numbers (prices, primary number 'Incluido en tu plan'), POST /api/numbers/extra (admin skips Stripe and goes to pendiente_aprobacion because there are no Zadarma API creds; a duplicate gives 409; a bad agent gives 404/422), PUT /api/numbers/{id} (assign/unassign, wrong country 422, agent already has an extra 409, primary number sets inbound_agent_id), DELETE (primary 409, extra marked liberado and gone from the list), GET /api/admin/numbers/extra plus approve (no Zadarma, so status=error with a message), cross-tenant 404 / non-admin 403, a client without a plan gets 409, and deleting an agent unassigns its extra number. Frontend, as admin at /app/numero: the panel renders; the picker lists only agents without a number; the confirm dialog shows the price and proration text; the 'Pedido recibido' toast appears and the row shows 'Pendiente de aprobar'; changing the select to 'Sin agente (libre)' gives the 'Número asignado' toast; deleting the row through the confirm dialog removes it. The panel is also on /app/telefonia, and the pending-approval panel is on /app/admin. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow. No JS errors. The code review found integration gaps where other modules still assume one tenant_numbers doc per tenant.

critical.issue: Only N.release(user_id) runs, which releases just the PRIMARY number. Extra numbers stay 'activo' (the Zadarma number and Vapi keep running and incurring cost, and inbound/outbound still work) after the subscription is cancelled. They should loop over the tenant's extra numbers and release each one (N.release(uid, r['_id'])).

minor.endpoint: onboarding.py mark_pending L50, assign L97/L107, block L126
minor.issue: update_one({'tenant_id': uid}) has no PRIMARY filter ({'extra': {'$ne': True}}). Once a tenant has extra numbers, these updates can hit an extra doc instead of the primary: admin pausing a line could pause an extra, and assigning a SIP line could overwrite an extra. Add **N.PRIMARY to these filters.
The dict {tenant_id: n} over all tenant_numbers lets extra docs overwrite the primary, so 'Altas pendientes' can show the extra's number/status. Filter with extra != True.
Keyed by tenant_id, so it counts only one number per tenant. Extra numbers' Zadarma costs are not included in the real-cost reports.
The list now includes extra docs, but _out() has no id/extra/agent flag, so the admin can't tell them apart. The release action is per-user and always releases the primary.

If status is 'comprando' (provision in flight), the doc is marked liberado without a release, and the running provision() can later set it back to activo. That leaves a live, uncharged number (the Stripe item was already removed).

Sets inbound_agent_id on extra docs (unused, since extras use agent_id). Also, a provision failure after the Stripe charge leaves the client charged with status=error until an admin approves a retry. The client email still says 'Tu número ... ya está activo' without naming the agent.

issues: In extra rows the trash button wraps onto a second line under the phone icon (flex-wrap inside max-w-2xl with a w-56 select). It looks orphaned; consider a fixed row layout or a shorter select.
The extra-row select lists every agent of the same country, including ones that already have an extra. Picking one gives a 409 toast; those could be filtered or disabled the way the add-picker does.

action_items: HIGH: on subscription cancel (billing webhook), also release every extra number of the tenant (and the Stripe items go with the subscription).
Add the PRIMARY filter (extra != True) to the onboarding.py updates (mark_pending, assign, block) and to the /admin/onboarding nums map.
Include extra numbers in costs_real (count per tenant/country, not a dict keyed by tenant).
Super admin /admin/numbers: expose id/extra/agent and make release per number.
DELETE extra while 'comprando': block it (409) or have provision() re-check status before setting activo.
UI: keep the trash button inline in extra rows; filter the extra-row select to agents without another extra.
critical_code_review_comments: Several modules still assume one tenant_numbers doc per tenant (onboarding.py, costs_real, billing cancel, admin numbers list). Audit every db.tenant_numbers query by tenant_id.
add_extra charges Stripe before the insert and provision. A crash in between leaves an orphan subscription item; consider inserting first and charging after, or a compensating uncharge on exception.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_Num_* agents and extra numbers and clean them up (extras end up status=liberado, agents deleted), plus registered test_num_*@example.com client users. One pre-existing extra (pendiente_aprobacion, agent Marta, id 6ad88c23ee6f15ae5bbe9321) was created by the main agent and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: There are no Zadarma API creds in platform_settings 'zadarma_api', so POST /numbers/extra goes to pendiente_aprobacion and approve sets status=error. No real numbers get bought. The admin role skips the Stripe charge in _charge. The UI panel testids are agent-numbers-panel, agent-numbers-pick, agent-numbers-add-button, agent-numbers-confirm(-button), agent-number-assign-{id}, agent-number-remove-{id}, and pending-extra-numbers on /app/admin.
